description: This file contains PHPUnit test cases for the EmployeeReportingMethodService class in the OrangeHRM project, specifically testing employee reporting hierarchy functionalities within the Pim (Personnel Information Management) plugin module.

classes.name: EmployeeReportingMethodServiceTest
classes.description: Test suite for EmployeeReportingMethodService, covering its core functionalities related to employee reporting structures.

methods.name: setUp
methods.description: Initializes the test case environment, creating an instance of EmployeeReportingMethodService and populating test data.

methods.name: testGetEmployeeReportingMethodDao
methods.description: Verifies that the service returns an instance of EmployeeReportingMethodDao.

methods.name: testGetSubordinateListCountForEmployee
methods.description: Tests the method that retrieves the count of subordinates for an employee based on search criteria.

methods.name: testGetImmediateSupervisorListCountForEmployee
methods.description: Tests retrieval of the count of immediate supervisors for an employee.

methods.name: testGetSubordinateListForEmployee
methods.description: Verifies fetching a list of subordinate reports for an employee.

methods.name: testGetImmediateSupervisorListForEmployee
methods.description: Verifies fetching a list of immediate supervisor reports for an employee.

methods.name: testGetAccessibleAndAvailableSupervisorsIdCombinedList
methods.description: Tests merging accessible supervisor IDs with available supervisor IDs, ensuring correctness.

methods.name: testGetAlreadyAssignedSupervisorsSubordinatesAndSelfIdCombinedList
methods.description: Tests combining supervisor IDs, subordinate IDs, and employee's own ID into a single list.
